messages:
tara (AE): Kicking off POC for ThinClient prospect. They expect short spikes to 600 qps for ~90s, steady 120 qps. Need a simple ops runbook + rough cost delta between Hosted vs Dedicated. Also security Qs pending (HSM).

jess (SE): Ack. Draft plan below, quick notes first: target 95p latency < 200ms for short queries (~64 tokens). Use lightweight model variant and aggressive batching + KV prefix cache.

jess (SE): Test plan (short):
- smoke: 1 AZ, 20 qps for 5m to validate connectivity
- ramp: increase 20 -> 120 qps over 10m
- surge: hit 600 qps for 90s, then ramp down
- metrics: 50/95/99 p latency, cpu/gpu util, queue depth, token cost

jess (SE): Load harness: we normally use wrk for HTTP and a simple python harness for chat streams. Example wrk command:
```
wrk -t8 -c200 -d90s -s post.lua http://redwood-host/prod/generate
```
post.lua attaches sample prompt and headers.

max (SRE): Note on infra: Dedicated pools with autoscale handle burst better (faster queue drain). On Hosted we'd recommend configuring burst capacity and fallback to smaller model variant to keep SLA. KV cache warmup matters — first 30-60s of surge will see higher latency until cache fills.

oliver (infra): Also watch tail latency from KMS/HSM. If customer uses HSM-backed keys for artifact decryption we see +30-80ms on decrypt path occasionally. For a 200ms target that matters. Can we get their keyflow details?

tara (AE): They confirmed HSM for signing only. For model serving they want envelopes signed but key ops are in a separate service — still flagged in the security review. Sophie do we have that in the questionnaire?

sophie (sales-eng): I have the sec questionnaire. I'll flag HSM decrypt path as "out-of-band" and ask for flow diagram. Meanwhile, pricing: rough hosted incremental cost during surge ~ $0.045/token-equivalent? Need to translate to requests. Jess, can you do a quick cost estimate per 1k requests for their profile?

jess (SE): Quick calc assumptions: model = redwood-3-small-quant (approx 8 tokens per req average), effective tokens = 8 input + 32 output = 40 tokens per request. Hosted price example: $0.000045 per token -> $0.0018 per request.
- 1k requests = ~$1.80
- 600 qps for 90s = 54k requests -> ~$97 hosted in that surge window
Dedicated amortized cost depends on commitment; but for short bursts Dedicated with burst config reduces queueing and will cost via reserved + small overage. For rough decision: if they run frequent surges (>= daily), Dedicated likely cheaper.

max (SRE): Run notes: during the surge run we'll look for these signals to abort: queue depth > 2k, GPU util > 95% for >30s, 95p latency > 500ms. Add a circuit-breaker TTL 60s to avoid cascading.

jess (SE): Sample request trace snippet (from prior POC):
```
[2026-02-07 14:32:11] req=12345 p50=42ms p95=128ms p99=312ms tokens=38 model=3-small-quant node=gpu-8
```
Observation: cold-starts drove the p99 up; warm pool settles quickly.

oliver (infra): Networking ask: schedule surge from same AZ where Dedicated pool lives to avoid cross-AZ egress. If they test from their corp network, NAT gateway + corporate proxy might add 30-120ms. Recommend client-side synthetic from our cloud test agents + one remote run from their office.

tara (AE): Let's schedule smoke + ramp on Thursday 10am PT. Can y'all confirm availability? Also need a one-page cost summary for the customer deck.

sophie (sales-eng): Available. I'll draft the one-pager after the run numbers. Template: assumptions, per-1k reqs hosted, recommendation (Dedicated if > X daily surge minutes), security footnote about HSM decrypt risk.

max (SRE): I can own the run orchestration and the monitoring dashboard. Will add autoscale thresholds: scale-up at 70% GPU util, scale-down after 3m of <40%.

jess (SE): Quick checklist for Thursday:
- confirm test tokens + endpoint (tara)
- validate HSM flow doc (sophie)
- pre-warm prefix cache by sending 10k warm requests 5m prior
- set wrk script & attach p95 alerts
- record sample traces and cost calc

tara (AE): I'll ping the customer for endpoint + test creds now. Also note they asked about encryption-in-transit for Dedicated — remind infra team to include customer CA bundle on nodes.

ci-bot: Run scheduled by max for thread 4287659012. Smoke run Thursday 10:00 PT -> /runs/4287659012-smoke (status: planned).

oliver (infra): One more: if we fallback to a smaller model variant during capacity pressure, we should run a qa prompt set to ensure no regression in top-3 intents. Add that to the runbook.

jess (SE): Good call. I'll attach a 20-prompt QA set to the harness.

tara (AE): Perfect. Thanks team — let's reconvene after the surge run for numbers + slide. :thumbsup:

sophie (sales-eng): I'll also add a short note on expected bill shock and mitigation (burst caps + alerts).

max (SRE): Will export dashboard and compute a per-surge cost breakdown after the run.

jess (SE): TL;DR for customer deck: expected p95 ~120-220ms (hosted), surge window cost ~ $100 for single 90s 600qps spike; Dedicated recommended if spikes are frequent or strict tail latency required.

tara (AE): Nice. End of thread until Thursday run results.
